name: Calipers
text: Measure a parcel: you'll know its number for certain, and that it's one of 4 metals.

name: Vernier Calipers
text: Measure a parcel: you'll know its number for certain, and that it's one of 3 metals.

name: Micrometer
text: Measure a parcel: you'll know its number for certain, and that it's one of 2 metals.

name: Scratch Test
text: Test a parcel: you'll know its metal for certain, and that it's one of 4 numbers.

name: Acid Test
text: Test a parcel: you'll know its metal for certain, and that it's one of 3 numbers.

name: Assay
text: Test a parcel: you'll know its metal for certain, and that it's one of 2 numbers.

name: Unwrap
text: Open a parcel's wrapping: you'll know exactly what's inside.
